[[File:Bio-hound.jpg|thumb|right|An Imperial bio-hound covered in Flexi-Skin]]
'''Flexi-Skin''' was a mottled [[Color/Legends|gray]] artificial organism covering the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[bio-hound]]. It was malleable and could assume several shapes, including one that resembled a [[Worm/Legends|worm]] and a ball.
